# Pinned synthetic contract evidence

Never serve or publish this directory. All assignment/URL inputs here are
reference test fixtures, not this course's authorized materials.

`reference/` contains 14 unchanged files from City Lab v1.0.0
`38b1dfdd73d766ec1d01999216b24dfca2126fad`; each was also compared with Maze Lab
`70cc35d9ce828bcd5357f16fe85f303aa2d30cd9` and matched byte-for-byte.
`source-files.json` records their SHA256 hashes. `reference/tests/__init__.py` is
a local package marker rather than a copied reference component.

`corpus.json` freezes all 364 cases and 76 answer selections generated by the two
unchanged Python corpus modules. The live parity runner checks the frozen data
against those generators, then compares original JavaScript, independent Python,
the Island extension and JSON Schemas. No original repository is required.

Reuse follows the instructor's explicit Phase 4 authorization, not an inferred
general application license. Original code headers and synthetic labels remain.
See [ASSIGNMENT_COMPATIBILITY](../../../docs/ASSIGNMENT_COMPATIBILITY.md).
